ai_chat_vod.title: I trained an Ai on 380,000 Twitch Chat messages (VOD)
facts: The stream centers on training and testing an AI from a large archive of Twitch Chat messages.
A major problem was cleaning/moderating noisy chat data before it could be useful for training.
The resulting AI is compared with live chat behavior and becomes a new object for Doug/chat banter.

painting_charity.title: Twitch Chat makes a painting for Charity (then Doug and Chat play Worms WMD)
facts: Doug lets Twitch Chat collectively create an artwork intended for a charity auction.
Crowd-control and creative disagreement become the central challenge.
The art segment expands so much that the originally planned later activity is dropped.
